blocks: The SATS Externally Probe-Controlled Cryogenic Probe Station is a high-precision platform designed for temperature-dependent electrical and material characterization. It enables researchers to perform accurate probing, measurement, and observation from cryogenic to high-temperature environments without breaking the vacuum, ensuring measurement consistency and sample integrity.

External probe control enables repositioning or switching electrical contacts between electrodes without venting or breaking the vacuum chamber, significantly reducing downtime and maintaining clean, stable measurement conditions.
Supports operation from –196°C to +300°C, with optional upgrades up to +550°C, accommodating a wide range of experimental requirements from cryogenic to high-temperature studies.

Offers heating rates up to 50°C per minute and cooling rates up to 20°C per minute. Equipped with PID closed-loop control and a PT100 sensor for precise temperature management, achieving ±0.1°C stability and resolution for reproducible results.
Engineered for integration with vacuum systems and compatible with protective gases (such as N₂), ensuring oxidation-free testing and reliable material performance evaluation.
Incorporates an optical window for in-situ microscopic or camera-based observation, enabling real-time visual monitoring during experiments.
Provides smooth and precise probe movement from outside the chamber, allowing easy electrode adjustment or switching under controlled environmental conditions.
Semiconductor and Nanodevice Characterization – Facilitates detailed electrical and thermal analysis of semiconductor and nanoscale devices under controlled environments.
Temperature-Dependent I–V and C–V Measurements – Enables precise current–voltage and capacitance–voltage testing across variable temperature ranges.
Superconducting and Cryogenic Material Studies – Suitable for low-temperature analysis of superconducting materials and cryogenic phenomena.
Hall Effect and Contact Resistance Testing – Supports mobility, carrier concentration, and contact resistance measurements critical for semiconductor research.
Sensor and MEMS Device Evaluation – Ideal for performance assessment of micro-electromechanical systems and various sensor technologies under controlled thermal and vacuum conditions.

The SATs Muffle Furnace is designed for high-temperature material testing, heat treatment, sintering, and analytical research applications. Built with advanced insulation and intelligent control systems, it ensures precise and consistent heating for laboratory and industrial use.
Operates from ambient to 800°C / 1000°C / 1200°C / 1400°C / 1500°C, depending on the model configuration, suitable for a wide range of high-temperature applications.
Offers high accuracy of ±1°C, ensuring consistent and reliable temperature control during thermal experiments.

Advanced PID microprocessor-based controller for precise temperature regulation, optimized stability, and smooth thermal transitions.
Capable of achieving heating rates up to 30°C per minute, enabling rapid thermal response and experimental efficiency.

Integrated digital LED or touchscreen interface (optional) for real-time temperature monitoring and user-friendly operation.

SATS MedPstat 2.0 Advance is a high-performance, compact potentiostat/galvanostat designed for precise electrochemical measurements. It delivers excellent accuracy, versatility, and ease of use — ideal for research, academic, and industrial applications.

Cyclic Voltammetry (CV), Linear Sweep Voltammetry (LSV), Chronoamperometry, Open Circuit Potential (OCP), Differential Pulse Voltammetry (DPV), Square Wave Voltammetry (SWV), Chronopotentiometry, Charge–Discharge, Corrosion Analysis (Tafel), and Corrosion Analysis (Linear Polarization).
Operates within ±10 V range, suitable for a wide spectrum of electrochemical and galvanostatic testing conditions.
Maintains high accuracy of 0.1% of the setpoint or 1 mV (maximum), ensuring precise voltage control.
Provides a fine resolution of 152 µV for accurate potential adjustments during experiments.
Ensures 0.1% of setpoint or 1 mV (maximum) measurement accuracy for reliable potential monitoring.
Delivers high-resolution potential measurement capability at 156 µV.
±15 V compliance voltage provides operational flexibility across different electrochemical systems.
Supports ±250 mA maximum current, suitable for both low-current analytical and moderate-load electrochemical tests.
Offers 7 selectable ranges from 10 nA to 250 mA, accommodating both micro- and macro-scale measurements.
Accuracy of 0.5% of range or 50 pA (maximum) ensures dependable current detection and quantification.
Provides a fine resolution of 0.015% of range or 1.5 pA, allowing precise low-current measurements.
Achieves 1.52 nA current resolution, ensuring accurate control in galvanostatic operation mode.
Supports ±10 V potential measurement range in galvanostatic mode for flexible electrochemical analysis.
Ultra-high input impedance of 10 TΩ minimizes signal interference and enhances measurement precision.
Maintains a minimal input bias current of 1 pA, reducing noise and ensuring stable signal integrity.
